data.name: Selina Playa Venao
data.address: Av. Dr. Belisario Porras, Las Escobas del Venado, Provincia de Los Santos, Panama
data.description:
In a complex of thatched-roof buildings between Route 2 and Venao Beach, this relaxed hostel with Pacific Ocean views is 10 km from the Reserva Natural y Marina.
Bright, breezy dorms with wood-beamed ceilings feature free Wi-Fi, lockers and shared bathrooms. Private rooms add air-conditioning and nautical-themed decor; some have en suite bathrooms and/or balconies.
Amenities include a guest kitchen, and a restaurant with a bar, plus an outdoor pool. Yoga classes are offered. Campsites are also available.
